s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive abdominal distension with a large pelvic mass and intra-abdominal metastases
salient_findings: Poorly differentiated carcinoma on frozen section analysis
key_facts: 70-year-old woman
2-month history of progressive abdominal distension
Pelvic ultrasound revealed an 18-cm solid-cystic mass
Rich intralesional blood flow on ultrasound
Serum CA-125 level of 367.9 U/mL
Neuron-specific enolase of 24.83 ng/mL
CYFRA21-1 of 3.85 ng/mL
0.5 L of hemorrhagic ascites evacuated at laparotomy
20-cm right ovarian cystic and solid mass
Mass infiltrating the uterus, intestinal loops, and parietal pelvic wall
Diffuse peritoneal implants on the surface of the uterus and intestines
Left ovary, fallopian tube, and pelvic and para-aortic lymph nodes appeared normal

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive abdominal distension with a large pelvic mass and intra-abdominal metastases
salient_findings: Poorly differentiated carcinoma on frozen section analysis
key_facts: 70-year-old woman

Rich intralesional blood flow on ultrasound

shortlist.label: Ovarian serous carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: High serum CA-125 level and presence of a large pelvic mass with intra-abdominal metastases

shortlist.label: Ovarian carcinosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a large solid-cystic mass with rich intralesional blood flow and high mitotic rate

shortlist.label: Primary peritoneal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse peritoneal implants on the surface of the uterus and intestines

shortlist.label: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a large pelvic mass with hemorrhagic ascites and elevated CYFRA21-1 level

shortlist.label: Ovarian endometrioid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Infiltration of the uterus and presence of a large pelvic mass with solid and cystic components

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with a large ovarian mass, high serum CA-125 level, and diffuse peritoneal implants is most consistent with ovarian serous carcinoma, which is a common and aggressive subtype of ovarian cancer.

rejected.label: Ovarian carcinosarcoma
rejected.why: While carcinosarcomas can present with large masses and high CA-125 levels, the histologic description of trabecular and rosette-like formations of pleomorphic tumor cells is not typical for this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Primary peritoneal carcinoma
rejected.why: The presence of a large ovarian mass and the involvement of the ovary suggest that the primary site of the tumor is the ovary, rather than the peritoneum.

rejected.label: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The histologic description does not mention the characteristic clear cells or hobnail cells seen in clear cell carcinoma.

rejected.label: Ovarian endometrioid carcinoma
rejected.why: The histologic description and the presence of high serum CA-125 level are not typical for endometrioid carcinoma, which often has a more favorable prognosis and is associated with endometriosis.
